scope: every debt item raised across r94-r101 with final disposition closed / addressed / carried:<owner>, each with an evidence pointer

disposition_vocabulary.closed: resolved with verification in the delivered tree (commit, pinned case, landed doc, or rebuilt receipt)
disposition_vocabulary.addressed: action taken that retires or bounds the debt without a full gate-level close (dated addendum, recorded bound, convention, host resolution, erratum); residual named in disposition_detail where partial
disposition_vocabulary.carried: still open in the delivered r102 tree; carried_owner names the holder

counting_rules: an entry that restates or disposes of an earlier round's item is a carry_record (mirrored into the tracked item's trail), not a new item
ST (supersession) and PR (process observation) entries that only record intra-round bookkeeping are items with disposition addressed; they are kept so no source id is dropped
r100 has no debt-ledger file: its surface is the adjudicator's six conditions plus recorded FAILs/qualifications (see sources[6] anomaly)
totals.source_entries = own_items + carry_records and equals the sum of items_in_source across the eight sources
